07 / EVIDENCE & METHOD

Every number needs a definition.

What counts as a candidate visit?

Messages are sessionized using a 24-hour inactivity gap over the complete conversation history, then clipped to the 2026 observation period. The broad cohort contains strong and possible admission signals. The strict cohort contains only strong signals. A visit is an inquiry session, not a unique applicant.

How are topics and intent detected?

Deterministic rules classify customer-side text, including Arabic and English signals. Categories are unvalidated and require human review. Multiple topics and faculties can appear in a visit. Customer claims about payment or application are not verified outcomes.

How is response performance measured?

The first eligible business reply after a customer query determines latency. Visits must have a full 24-hour observation window before they enter the timely-reply denominator. Recent visits are excluded. Median latency describes observed replies, excluding unanswered queries. The export cannot reliably separate staff replies from automation.

What are repeated topics and review exposure?

A repeated topic has appeared in an earlier candidate visit from the same participant identifier. Repeat labels remain anchored to the full candidate-period history when filters change. Unique review exposure is the union of mature query visits with no timely reply, a repeated topic, or a friction flag; topic exposure requires repetition of that specific topic. This is a review queue, not a count of lost applicants.

How are period comparisons kept fair?

The matched comparison uses days 1–15 of August and September. Monthly visits per day use calendar days within export coverage, rather than only days with messages. September is partial. Changes are descriptive: seasonality and other influences cannot be isolated from this export.

Which results cannot be claimed?

Enrollment, admission conversion, lost revenue, campaign attribution, customer satisfaction, and causal improvement are unavailable. Impact scenarios use editable assumptions. Missing profile information means it was not detected in the conversation; it may exist in another system.
